notes.title: Demo V0.4: Automatic archiving
notes.content:
Demo V0.4 has been released, updated content:
- Implemented automatic saving (not yet supported in cloud)
- Added remaining steps display
- New Logo!
- Fixed some card errors
- Fixed some display errors
- Optimize task display
- Optimize the battle settlement process
- Optimize some UI

試玩版: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3142320

notes.title: The new version will import DEI content
notes.content:
In order to bring world peace and a better future, this game introduces new and diverse DEI content:
- Added 87 new genders
- Added 128 new races
- Added 256 skin tones
- Added 9999 new professions
After this update, you can be anyone! Even yourself!

Happy April Fools' Day!
